job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities:

Deliver production-grade features under senior engineering direction.
Write clean, testable, well-documented code that other engineers can maintain.
Participate actively in code reviews & design discussions.
Support test automation & integration efforts.
Contribute to team documentation & knowledge sharing.
Learn from senior engineers & grow toward independent ownership of larger scope.





Preferred candidate profile:

Technical must-have

3 to 5 years of hands-on software engineering experience.
Proficiency in Python (FastAPI, asyncio, Pydantic) & Java (JDK 21 or a recent LTS release).
Working experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred): schema design, queries, migrations.
Experience with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containers, & modern deployment (Docker, Kubernetes).
Familiarity with event-driven systems (Kafka or equivalent) & API design (REST, OpenAPI).
Testing practices, CI/CD, & code review culture.
Ability to write clean, testable, well-documented code that other engineers can maintain.
Strong communication skills & willingness to learn from senior engineers.

Nice to have

Time-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB, ClickHouse) or graph databases (Neo4j).
Stream processing frameworks (Kafka Streams, Flink).
Applied machine learning familiarity: PyTorch, sklearn, XGBoost, or MLflow, or genuine curiosity to learn on the

job.

LLM application engineering interest: agentic AI, prompt orchestration, tool calling, or side projects using LLMs.
Frontend familiarity (React with TypeScript) for dashboards.
OpenTelemetry or similar observability practices.
Any exposure to telecom, network operations, or infrastructure software.
